<template>
  <v-container fluid class="pa-0">
    <v-overlay :model-value="loading" class="align-center justify-center">
      <v-progress-circular
        color="primary"
        indeterminate
        size="64"
      ></v-progress-circular>

      <v-row no-gutters>
        <v-col cols="12">
          <v-data-table
            :headers="headers"
            :items="positions"
            :loading="tableLoading"
            :search="search"
            :items-per-page="itemsPerPage"
            class="elevation-1 nowrap-table"
            density="compact"
            @update:sort-by="handleSortChange"
            :server-items-length="totalItems"
            :items-length="totalItems"
            must-sort
            disable-sort
          >

          <template #top>
            <v-toolbar flat class="bg-grey-lighten-4 border-b">
              <v-col cols="12" sm="3" md="2" lg="2">
                <v-row>
                  <v-col cols="12" sm="6">
                    <v-menu
                      ref="transactionsTableFrom"
                      v-model="transactionsTableFrom"
                      :close-on-content-click="false"
                      transition="scale-transition"
                      offset-y
                      min-width="auto"
                    >
                      <template v-slot:activator="{ on, attrs }">
                        <v-text-field
                          v-model="dateFrom"
                          label="From"
                          prepend-icon="mdi-calendar"
                          readonly
                          v-bind="attrs"
                          v-on="on"
                          density="compact"
                          hide-details
                        ></v-text-field>
                      </template>
                      <v-date-picker
                        v-model="dateFrom"
                        @input="menuFrom = false"
                      ></v-date-picker>
                    </v-menu>
                  </v-col>
                  <v-col cols="12" sm="6">
                    <v-menu
                      ref="transactionsTableTo"
                      v-model="transactionsTableTo"
                      :close-on-content-click="false"
                      transition="scale-transition"
                      offset-y
                      min-width="auto"
                    >
                      <template v-slot:activator="{ on, attrs }">
                        <v-text-field
                          v-model="dateTo"
                          label="To"
                          prepend-icon="mdi-calendar"
                          readonly
                          v-bind="attrs"
                          v-on="on"
                          density="compact"
                          hide-details
                        ></v-text-field>
                      </template>
                      <v-date-picker
                        v-model="dateTo"
                        @input="menuTo = false"
                      ></v-date-picker>
                    </v-menu>
                  </v-col>
                </v-row>
              </v-col>
              <v-col cols="12" sm="6" md="7" lg="8">
              </v-col>
            </v-toolbar>
          </template>

          </v-data-table>
        </v-col>
      </v-row>

    </v-overlay>
  </v-container>
</template>

<script>
import {onMounted,onUnmounted,ref,computed} from 'vue'
import {useStore} from 'vuex'

export default {
    name:"TransactionsPage",
    emits:['update-page-title'],
    setup(props,{emit}){
      const store = useStore()

      const dateFrom = ref('')
      const dateTo = ref('')
      const loading = computed(()=> store.state.loading)

      onMounted(()=>{
        emit('update-page-title','Transactions')
      })
      onUnmounted(()=>{
        emit('update-page-title','')
      })

      return {
        dateFrom,
        dateTo,
        loading
      }
    }
    
}

</script>
